Invoice.label: Customer Invoice
Invoice.description: Customer invoice posting — trade receivables (411) debited, revenue and/or deferred revenue credited.

419.detail: Customer advance account (419) used instead of trade receivables (411) — check customer posting profile.

487.detail: Revenue deferred (487) on invoice but Revenue Recognition module may not be enabled — verify Revenue Recognition setup if deferral is unintended.

Revenue.label: Revenue Recognition
Revenue.description: Release of deferred revenue to the P&L income statement upon meeting recognition criteria.

411.detail: AR account (411) debited on a revenue recognition entry — recognition should release 487 deferred revenue, not create a new AR balance.

COGS.label: Cost of Goods Sold
COGS.description: Inventory issue on shipment — COGS expense debited, inventory balance sheet account credited.

entries.label: Cost of Goods Sold / Variation of Stock

601.detail: Raw material purchase account (601) used for COGS — COGS should reflect stock movement (607/6037). Check Item Group Posting COGS account.

401.detail: Vendor payable (401) credited on a COGS entry — inventory account (311-371) should be credited, not a payable.
